newsitem.title: UK: Bangladesh buys cargo low-quality white sugar-trade.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh buys cargo low-quality white sugar-trade.

text.p: Bangladesh bought one cargo of low-quality white sugar at around $346 per tonne c & f from a leading London trade house, sugar traders said on Monday.
The sugar, whose quality was 150 ICUMSA, was most likely to be Indian in origin, they said.
Bangladesh tendered last week to buy the sugar with a specified shipment period of March 11/April 11.
Last July, Bangladesh's state-owned Sugar and Food Industries Corporation bought 12,500 tonnes of white sugar at $371 per tonne c & f for August shipment.
